Take full ownership of your personal AI assistant by running OpenClaw locally on your hardware with native integrations across all your favorite chat apps and devices. 🤖💻

Tired of closed, cloud-hosted AI assistants fragmenting your workflow and compromising your data? OpenClaw solves this by providing a self-hosted, open-source control plane (the Gateway) that connects local or hosted LLMs directly to popular messaging platforms and companion devices, keeping your state, memory, and credentials entirely on your own iron.

Key features built for developers and power users:
⚡ Multi-Channel Support: Integrates natively with Discord, iMessage, Slack, Teams, Telegram, WhatsApp, and 20+ other chat services out of the box.
🔒 Local State and Security: State and credentials reside entirely on your hardware with opt-in telemetry and a trusted gateway architecture.
🧩 Extensible Plugin SDK: Swap out model harnesses, add custom tools, skills, and plugins, or distribute capabilities via ClawHub.
📱 Cross-Platform Companion Apps: Native apps and nodes for macOS, iOS, Android, Windows, and Linux enabling voice, canvas, and device-local actions.

Whether you are building a personalized, multi-platform DevOps bot that coordinates alerts across Slack and Telegram, or running a completely private, local-model-backed assistant that manages local files without leaking data, OpenClaw gives you a production-ready framework to orchestrate autonomous agents without relying on third-party SaaS wrappers.

👉 Check out the repo and start self-hosting today: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw

Transform a sluggish, ad-bloated smart TV into a lightning-fast display using just a conversational prompt and an LLM! 📺⚡

If you are tired of modern smart TVs crawling under heavy sponsored rows, background telemetry, and resource-hogging system animations, there is finally a better way. 

Ansub/tv-detox bridges high-level agentic AI with low-level hardware control. Using LLM-powered coding assistants like Claude Code or Codex, it interacts with Android TV via ADB to safely audit, strip, and supercharge your display without breaking core functionality.

🔍 Key Features:
• LLM-Driven System Audit: AI analyzes installed apps in plain English, sorting them into safe-to-disable, required system services, and user apps.
• Safety Guardrails & Automated Rollback: Enforces strict whitelists for critical dependencies like Google Play services and System UI, complete with comprehensive undo scripts.
• Hardware-Specific Optimization: Automates UI performance tweaks by killing system animations, setting aggressive sleep timers, and managing OLED burn-in protection.
• Cross-Version ADB Compatibility: Seamlessly handles both standard USB debugging and modern wireless debugging workflows with pairing ports.

For developers and systems engineers, this repo serves as a stellar blueprint for agentic system administration. Learn how to structure strict guardrails, multi-step prompt workflows, and automated rollback logic for safely mutating remote headless or embedded environments. 

Check out the source code and start hacking your consumer hardware today:
https://github.com/Ansub/tv-detox

Stop letting your local AI coding agents work in total isolation! 🤖🧱

Reason Network bridges peer-to-peer networking and the Model Context Protocol to let your local AI coding agents collaborate directly across machines, end-to-end encrypted. 

Most developer AI setups today are completely siloed, leaving your coding assistants unable to talk to each other across different computers without routing sensitive source code through third-party cloud servers. 

Reason Network solves this by establishing a secure, E2EE peer-to-peer network across machines. Now, AI coding agents running on different computers can discover each other, check status, send messages, exchange code files, and coordinate complex tasks with absolute privacy.

Key features you get out of the box:
🔒 End-to-end encrypted P2P transport powered by iroh with privacy-preserving relay fallbacks.
🔌 Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration giving agents tools like list_team, send_message, check_inbox, and ask_user.
👀 Cross-agent state visibility showing active repositories, branches, and busy or idle statuses across teammate sessions.
🛡️ Human-in-the-loop approval workflows via desktop pop-ups for any actions requiring your explicit authorization.

Whether you are coordinating multi-agent code reviews across distributed developer rigs or passing code contexts between local sessions, you can now orchestrate multi-agent workflows without managing complex cloud infrastructure.

Check out the repo, drop a star, and start building your decentralized AI dev team today:
https://github.com/reason-machines/reason-network

Turn any physical room into an interactive Three.js web experience using an iPhone LiDAR scan and an AI coding agent. 🏠✨

If you have ever tried to translate a real-world space into a lightweight, interactive web 3D model, you know how tedious the workflow can be. Bridging physical space capture with web-native 3D environments usually involves hours of manual modeling and geometry cleanup.

wesbos/3d-model-anything solves this by automating the heavy lifting. It combines an iPhone app to record room geometry and photos with an AI agent skill that guides an LLM through measuring, modeling, and iteratively reconstructing the space into clean, editable code.

Notable Features:
📱 LiDAR-equipped iPhone app capture that packages room geometry and photo collections for spatial data export.
🤖 AI coding agent skill designed to interpret raw scan exports, execute measurements, and build editable Three.js scenes.
🔍 Matched-camera visual comparison tooling that enables iterative refinement between the generated 3D scene and original photographs.
🕹️ Versatile Three.js runtime viewer featuring multiple perspectives including dollhouse, walking, overhead, wireframe, and knolling views.

Whether you are building interactive virtual office tours, digital twins for your portfolio, or prototyping interior design and architectural walkthroughs directly in the browser, this repository dramatically lowers the barrier to entry for spatial computing workflows.

Check out the repository and start building:
https://github.com/wesbos/3d-model-anything

Tired of renting your digital life to big tech and dealing with endless SaaS price hikes? 

Reclaim your digital sovereignty and data privacy by replacing centralized SaaS providers with a massive curated directory of over 100 categories of free, open-source self-hosted applications.

Whether you are a DevOps engineer, sysadmin, or a homelab hobbyist, setting up your own infrastructure often hits a wall when you are searching for reliable, production-ready alternatives to commercial tools. 

`awesome-selfhosted` solves this by giving you a comprehensive knowledge base of free software network services that you can run on your own servers using Docker and Kubernetes. 

Notable Features:
- Massive categorization covering everything from analytics, automation, and backup solutions to generative AI, media streaming, and dev tools.
- Automated maintenance workflows that continuously check for dead links and unmaintained projects.
- Clear licensing and tech stack indicators to help you quickly evaluate software suitability.
- Available as both a user-friendly HTML version and a legacy Markdown catalog.

Use it to spin up a private analytics stack, build an isolated developer toolchain, cut licensing costs, and keep your data entirely under your control.

Check out the repository and star it to build your ultimate homelab stack:
https://github.com/awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted
